aggressive_definition: Advanced incident prostate cancer; the abstract does not provide a more detailed staging definition.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: After 20.3 years of follow-up, 3,868 prostate cancer cases (advanced: 1,256) and 1,884 bladder cancer cases could be included in multivariable Cox proportional hazards analyses.
study_design: Prospective cohort analysis within the Netherlands Cohort Study using baseline dietary assessment and 20.3 years of follow-up.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Data were available for 58,279 men and 62,573 women, who completed a baseline questionnaire on diet and other cancer risk factors.
reason: The abstract analyzes prostate cancer incidence and distinguishes advanced from nonadvanced disease. It reports an advanced prostate cancer estimate and also discusses prostate cancer and nonadvanced prostate cancer risk, supporting both general and aggressive incident analyses.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: aMEDr was not associated with advanced prostate cancer risk [hazard ratio (HR)<sub>per 2-point increment</sub> (95% confidence interval, 95% CI) = 1.06 (0.96-1.17)].
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate explicitly concerns advanced incident prostate cancer and therefore meets the aggressive endpoint definition.
